findings.expected: Identical settlement retry must return saved result without duplicate financial effects.
findings.actual: Sales and purchase partial retries each produce paid2000 vs1000, two treasury entries/two audits; operationId400.
findings.smallest_safe_remediation: Transactional actor-scoped operation ID/content hash and saved response after current authorization.

findings.expected: Requested countable maintenance quantities must survive selection/offline queue/approval/analytics/PPTX with provenance.
findings.smallest_safe_remediation: Additive per-visit reason quantities, countability, legacy provenance, audited corrections and downstream aggregation/export.
findings.required_acceptance_test: Positive integer validation, distinct historical default1, multiple reasons/quantities through approved records and PPTX.

findings.expected: Late GPS ingestion must not reopen a closed duty session.
findings.actual: Worker always sends onDuty:true; open sessions0→1 after closed-session backlog.
findings.smallest_safe_remediation: Separate ingestion from duty transitions and persist originating session association.
findings.required_acceptance_test: Closed-session backlog stored/acknowledged without new session/attendance effects.

findings.expected: Stable GPS identity must reject changed-content reuse and survive installs/accounts.
findings.actual: Server does not persist clientPointId/hash; changed coordinate/time under reused ID accepted.
findings.smallest_safe_remediation: Persist owner-scoped globally stable installation/point identity and canonical hash.
findings.required_acceptance_test: Identical replay duplicate; conflicting content rejected; same-time distinct points and cross-install/account handling explicit.

findings.expected: Distributed release must use approved signing, nondebug configuration and reviewed provenance.
findings.actual: Actual fallback APK Android Debug signed, debuggable, disagrees with current generated web assets.
findings.smallest_safe_remediation: Reviewed release process preserving approved certificate and version progression; do not replace during audit.
findings.required_acceptance_test: Endpoint bytes/hash/signature/version/URL/source manifest plus pending-preserving device upgrade.

findings.expected: Native-only queued machine actions must appear in recovery UI/export.
findings.actual: Only preexisting IDB actions are merged; native-only actions omitted.
findings.smallest_safe_remediation: Merge native authoritative action records/evidence/ownership into UI and export.
findings.required_acceptance_test: Delete fixture IDB mirror; native-only work remains visible/retryable/exportable with files.

findings.expected: Offered recovery export must have a defined safe restore/import path when recovery is claimed.
findings.actual: No matching exported-JSON importer found; native backup restoration is different.
findings.smallest_safe_remediation: Define versioned owner/hash-validated import or explicitly narrow recovery promise.
findings.required_acceptance_test: All queue/file types roundtrip; wrong owner/malformed/duplicate content rejected safely.

findings.expected: Server assurance label must match what client assertion proves.
findings.actual: Biometric true boolean stored; weak biometric/device credential allowed; no signed server challenge/attestation.
findings.smallest_safe_remediation: Label local device-authentication assertion accurately; product decision for stronger proof.
findings.required_acceptance_test: Forged boolean is never reported as cryptographic biometric proof; verify PIN-fallback wording/device behavior.

findings.expected: Interrupted local evidence write must preserve/recover old or new committed bytes.
findings.actual: Source deletes target before temp rename; no corresponding recovery scan/hash binding found.
findings.smallest_safe_remediation: Atomic immutable evidence/manifest with hashes and interrupted-temp recovery.
findings.required_acceptance_test: Crash between delete/rename preserves/reconstructs evidence; changed-photo reuse conflicts. Device injection still blocked.

findings.expected: Reviewed source, loaded deployment, endpoint artifact and installed app must correspond.
findings.actual: No loaded backend SHA or live authenticated APK byte/override proof; no installed-device baseline.
findings.smallest_safe_remediation: Revision-bound build/deployment manifest and authorized endpoint/device evidence.
findings.required_acceptance_test: Trace approved SHA→signed build→live bytes→installed version/cert; clean Git status alone insufficient.

findings.expected: Business event guarantee must survive postcommit append failure.
findings.actual: Event persistence error swallowed; actual probe delivers live-only event that cannot replay.
findings.smallest_safe_remediation: Transactional outbox/event append and postcommit fanout.
findings.required_acceptance_test: Inject append failure and crash after business commit; durable replay or explicit recovery signal remains.

findings.expected: Stale event cursor must lead to authoritative state recovery.
findings.actual: Retained suffix silently returned; foreground APIs mitigate, complete UI recovery not demonstrated.
findings.smallest_safe_remediation: Explicit cursor floor/reset and full refresh on connect/reconnect.
findings.required_acceptance_test: Expire cursor then compare browser/native state to authoritative route/review/attendance APIs.

findings.smallest_safe_remediation: Approved ownership/mode hardening without changing application business data.
findings.required_acceptance_test: Unprivileged host user cannot read/write keys, DB or backups while service/restore works.

findings.expected: Disaster recovery needs an approved protected off-device archive and drill.
findings.actual: Only local ZIP count and isolated current-schema tests; no off-device/real drill evidence.
findings.smallest_safe_remediation: Authorize isolated off-device restore drill and historical-version support matrix.
findings.required_acceptance_test: Integrity/FK/history/attachment manifests and failed/interrupted recovery yield usable isolated app.

findings.expected: Pipeline labels must not imply patch/build/ADB/release verification without real operations.
findings.actual: Manual trigger plus four empty noOp nodes; no execution evidence for this workflow.
findings.smallest_safe_remediation: Relabel documentary or replace only with separately authorized genuine runner integration.
findings.required_acceptance_test: A real failed build/device result visibly fails; unavailable device remains blocked. Severity high if treated as release gate.

findings.expected: Architecture labels must reflect audited source.
findings.actual: Live map stale on cash settlement, durable event replay and offcuts.
findings.smallest_safe_remediation: Review new evidence map; no live overwrite performed.
findings.required_acceptance_test: Map IDs/status/evidence/source SHA match final inventory.

findings.expected: Schedule operation requires execution evidence beyond active config.
findings.actual: Actual scheduled execution25 at06Cairo returned WARN; scope only7operational/subset checks.
findings.smallest_safe_remediation: Keep operational execution evidence separate from CI/release/device acceptance.
findings.required_acceptance_test: Retain real execution scope/time/status; no implied alerts or complete release certification.

findings.expected: Optional alerts need an authorized destination and delivered-notification evidence.
findings.actual: No configured alert node/credential/destination; execution result alone.
findings.smallest_safe_remediation: Product/operations choose and authorize destination; no live modification in audit.
findings.required_acceptance_test: Actual delivered notification evidence distinct from workflow success.
